python -c "import collections, pathlib, tempfile
from sparkforge.codeintel.db import abrir
from sparkforge.codeintel.index import indexar
from sparkforge.codeintel.refs import extrair_referencias
from sparkforge.codeintel.resolve import catalogo_do_banco, resolver
from sparkforge.facts.scan import iter_source_files
R = pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
b = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / 'g.sqlite3'
indexar(R, b)
cat = catalogo_do_banco(abrir(b))
refs = {}
for p in iter_source_files(R, '*.py'):
    rel = p.resolve().relative_to(R).as_posix()
    try:
        refs[rel] = extrair_referencias(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), rel)
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, SyntaxError):
        continue
r = resolver(refs, cat)
u = collections.Counter(n.reason for n in r.nao_resolvidas)['UNKNOWN_RECEIVER']
print('unknownreceiver=%s%%' % str(round(100 * u / len(r.nao_resolvidas), 1)).replace('.', ','))"
